text:
emily: FYI CI threw a bunch of linkcheck warnings on the docusaurusify branch. Mostly image paths and a couple of anchor mismatches.
raj: Which warnings exactly?
emily: Example from the log: "WARN Broken link: /docs/migrate#rlhf-> /docs/migrate#rlhf-architecture (link target not found)" and several "Static file not found: static/img/api-compare.png"
tori: Ah yeah, during the migration we moved images from /assets/img/* to /static/img/* for Docusaurus. Some relative references stayed as "../assets/img/..." and the linkcheck can't find them.
build-bot: Linkcheck job failed (12 broken links, 5 missing static files).
raj: Quick fix: use useBaseUrl('/img/api-compare.png') for React/mdx components or absolute /docs/img/ path for plain markdown. Also replace ../assets/img with /img when moving to docusaurus.
emily: There's also the anchor mismatch: the markdown header was "## RLHF Architecture" but the link was to #rlhf-architecture because our mkdocs slugify included lowercase spaces -> dash. Docusaurus slugger does the same but we had a manual override elsewhere.
tori: We should avoid manual #anchors in content unless necessary. Better: link to the page and rely on the auto-generated id, e.g. [/migrate#rlhf-architecture](/docs/migrate#rlhf-architecture). I'll run a small script to normalize local anchor references to the canonical slug.
andre: Can we add a docs CI step to fail fast when static files referenced in changed markdown are missing? Something like: for each changed .mdx: parse image refs -> assert file exists in static/ or assets/.
emily: Yes please. I can add a quick Node script:
```js
// simple check used in PRs
const refs = extractImages(changedFile);
refs.forEach(r => { if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(projectRoot, 'static', r))) { console.error('missing', r); process.exit(1); } });
```
raj: Also update CONTRIBUTING.md: during migration prefer /img/* (static) and avoid ../assets/ paths. Add a short troubleshooting note about Docusaurus useBaseUrl and mkdocs base differences.
tori: I'll file a tiny PR to auto-fix obvious ../assets/ -> /img/ and to run the script in the linkcheck workflow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1240
emily: Local preview looks good after the replacements. CI now reports 0 missing static files but one remaining anchor mismatch still shows.
andre: Which anchor?
emily: /docs/migrate referencing #token-cache but the heading is "Token cache details" which slugifies to #token-cache-details. The source had #token-cache manually in a link.
raj: We should add a lint rule to detect manual anchors that don't match heading slugs. Could use markdown-it to compute slugs and compare.
tori: I'll add that to the lint job. For now I'll update the manual link.
emily: Done and merged. CI green. Thanks everyone. :tada:
